parameters.help_en: The ID of the target session for sending a message or resuming a run
parameters.help_zh: 发送消息或恢复运行的目标会话 ID
parameters.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the file after it is uploaded
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: The original name of the file
fields.name: source_name

parameters.example: 请查询示例资源状态，不执行变更。
parameters.help_en: The message text in MESSAGE mode. This parameter cannot be empty. The type parameter can be omitted in this mode
parameters.help_zh: MESSAGE 模式的消息文本，不能为空。该模式可省略 type
parameters.name: content

fields.help_en: The ID of the interrupt to be replied to. Obtain this value from data.outcome.interrupts[].id in the SSE RUN_FINISHED event or the GetRun response
fields.help_zh: 待回复的中断 ID。取自 SSE `RUN_FINISHED` 事件的 `data.outcome.interrupts[].id`，或 `GetRun` 响应的 `data.outcome.interrupts[].id`
fields.name: interrupt_id

fields.help_en: The interrupt handling result. This parameter is required when status is set to resolved and must conform to the responseSchema of the corresponding interrupt. Do not pass this parameter when status is set to cancelled
fields.help_zh: 中断处理结果。status 为 resolved 时必填，须符合对应中断的 responseSchema；为 cancelled 时不传
fields.name: payload

fields.help_en: The reply method for the interrupt. Valid values: resolved (submits the answer, confirmation, or tool result required by the interrupt, and must include payload) and cancelled (cancels the interrupt without passing payload)
fields.help_zh: 本次中断的回复方式：`resolved` 表示提交中断要求的回答、确认或工具结果，必须携带 `payload`；`cancelled` 表示取消该中断，不传 `payload`
fields.name: status

parameters.help_en: The list of interrupt replies. This parameter is required when type is set to RESUME. You must reply to all pending interrupts at once. Each interruptId can appear only once
parameters.help_zh: 中断回复列表，`type=RESUME` 时必填。须一次回复当前全部待处理中断，每个 `interruptId` 只能出现一次
parameters.name: resume

parameters.help_en: The ID of the active run to resubscribe to. This parameter is required in RECONNECT mode
parameters.help_zh: RECONNECT 模式必填，指定需要重新订阅的活动运行 ID
parameters.name: run_id

parameters.help_en: The request type. Valid values: MESSAGE (sends a message), RESUME (resumes a run), and RECONNECT (reconnects to a run). Default value: MESSAGE
parameters.help_zh: 请求类型。取值：`MESSAGE`（发送消息）、`RESUME`（恢复运行）、`RECONNECT`（重连运行）。默认值：`MESSAGE`
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The idempotency key for the request. Use the same key and the same business parameters when retrying the same request
parameters.help_zh: 请求幂等键。重试同一请求应使用相同键和相同业务参数
parameters.name: x_open_agent_idempotency_key

schema.description_en: The Server-Sent Events (SSE) event stream. The Content-Type is text/event-stream. Each business frame contains an event and data in JSON format. The event matches data.type. The example shows the simplest lifecycle without text increments
schema.description_zh: SSE 事件流，Content-Type 为 text/event-stream。每个业务帧包含 event 和 JSON 格式的 data，event 与 data.type 一致。示例为不含文本增量的最简生命周期

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. Select the structure that corresponds to MESSAGE, RESUME, or RECONNECT based on the type parameter. Do not mix fields from different structures
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。按 type 选择 MESSAGE、RESUME 或 RECONNECT 对应结构，不能混用字段
v1_body_parameters.name: body
